notes: Consent framework grounded in existing consent_service and lead_capture integration; primary risk is HIPAA compliance correctness and data handling boundaries.

stories.title: Consent Schema and Tier Contract Definition
stories.description: Define canonical schema for two-tier HIPAA consent including fields for tier_level (Tier 1 anonymous / Tier 2 identifiable), consent_timestamp, consent_text_version, user_identifier linkage, and storage rules. Establish validation contract across services.

stories.title: Core Consent Logic and Tier Enforcement
stories.description: Implement core logic enforcing two-tier consent: Tier 1 allows de-identified interaction only; Tier 2 enables identifiable data storage and lead capture. Include upgrade path from Tier 1 to Tier 2 and strict prevention of PHI storage without Tier 2.

stories.title: Consent API and Service Interfaces
stories.description: Expose backend interfaces for capturing consent, checking consent status, and upgrading consent tier. Ensure integration points for tool_router and downstream services (lead capture, unknown question handling).

stories.title: De-identification and Storage Enforcement
stories.description: Implement enforcement that all Tier 1 interactions are de-identified using HIPAA Safe Harbor rules before persistence, and validate that identifiable data is only stored when Tier 2 consent is present.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Testing and Integration
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating consent capture, tier transitions, enforcement of storage rules, and integration with lead capture and unknown question flows.

per_feature.mitigation: Strict enforcement of Tier 2 requirement before any identifiable data persistence and reuse existing consent_service patterns.
